As a Network Security Operations Engineer , you will be responsible for providing operational security support across network environments, analysing security incidents and risks, and implementing protective controls to ensure the availability, integrity, and security of client networks. Responsibilities: Provide ongoing operational support and management of network environments, ensuring high availability, stability, and adherence to agreed service levels. Work closely with clients to understand operational requirements, business priorities, and network support needs, ensuring services align with day‑to‑day business operations. Perform regular health checks, audits, and operational reviews of network infrastructure to identify risks, incidents, and opportunities for improvement. Support and maintain network configurations, documentation, and operational runbooks, ensuring accuracy and readiness for operational and incident scenarios. Lead and participate in incident management, problem resolution, and root cause analysis for complex network issues, ensuring timely restoration and prevention of recurrence. Conduct network performance monitoring, capacity management, and utilization analysis to proactively address performance bottlenecks and scalability needs. Support change management activities, including validation, implementation, and post‑change monitoring, ensuring minimal business disruption. Collaborate with cross‑functional operational teams (service desk, system administrators, security, and application teams) to deliver integrated and coordinated support. Apply operational best practices, standards, and compliance requirements to ensure process consistency and operational governance. Stay current with modern network technologies and operational trends, recommending improvements that enhance reliability, resilience, and operational efficiency. Provide day‑to‑day guidance and mentoring to junior engineers, supporting skill development, operational maturity, and knowledge transfer within the team. Requirements: B.E./B.Tech in Computer Science, Information Technology, or a related field. 6-9 years of experience in network consulting, design, and implementation, preferably in a client-facing role. Strong hands‑on experience with FireMon, Check Point firewalls, and Zscaler platforms in a network security operations environment. Proficient in network protocols and technologies such as TCP/IP, DNS, BGP, OSPF, MPLS, VLANs, VPNs, and firewalls. Strong expertise in modern network technologies, including but not limited to SD-WAN, virtualization, cloud networking, software-defined networking (SDN), and network automation. Hands-on experience with network equipment from leading vendors, such as Cisco, Juniper, Arista, etc. Expertise on Ansible for seamless automation of IP network configurations, optimizing the deployment and management of networking infrastructure. Expertise on Terraform to define and provision IP network resources, ensuring consistent and scalable network architectures. Proficient in cloud networking technologies and Secure Access Service Edge (SASE). Familiarity with network monitoring and management tools, such as Wireshark, SolarWinds, or Nagios. Excellent analytical and problem-solving skills, with the ability to assess complex network requirements and propose effective solutions. Strong communication and interpersonal skills, capable of effectively presenting technical concepts to both technical and non-technical stakeholders. Industry certifications from vendors like Cisco, Juniper, Zscaler, Palo Alto, Fortinet etc. are highly desirable. In this role, you will ensure employees have the tools, access, and technical support they need to work effectively in a fast-paced fintech environment. You will work hands-on with platforms such as Okta, MDM solutions, Google Workspace, and cloud-based applications, while supporting device security, meeting room technology, and IT infrastructure projects. Support Windows and macOS environments, ensuring end-user devices remain functional, secure, and up to date. Troubleshoot connectivity and access issues, including network connectivity, VPN, printers, and other workplace technologies. Install, configure, and maintain meeting room devices and related equipment to support smooth meetings and collaboration. Identity and Access Management Support and administer identity and access management through Okta , including user provisioning, access requests, and Single Sign-On (SSO) troubleshooting. Assist with user access management and ensure appropriate access permissions are maintained in accordance with internal security requirements. Troubleshoot authentication and access-related issues and escalate complex cases when required. MDM and Endpoint Security Assist with Mobile Device Management (MDM) administration, including device enrollment, compliance monitoring, security policies, and remote support. Support endpoint security requirements, including patching, antivirus protection, access controls, and other applicable security measures. Help ensure end-user devices comply with internal IT security standards and operational requirements. Business Applications and SaaS Support Provide support for Google Workspace and other workplace collaboration tools. Assist with the administration and troubleshooting of SaaS applications, including cloud-based platforms such as AWS and GCP. Investigate application-related issues and coordinate with relevant internal teams or vendors for resolution when necessary. IT Operations and Documentation Maintain accurate documentation of IT incidents, troubleshooting steps, resolutions, and recurring issues. Maintain and update IT asset inventory records to ensure accurate tracking of company devices and equipment. Escalate complex technical issues to Senior Engineers, relevant internal teams, or external vendors as appropriate. Follow established IT support procedures and contribute to continuous improvements in support processes and service delivery. Project Support and Other Duties Support the provisioning and implementation of IT infrastructure-related projects, including device setup, configuration, and deployment activities. Collaborate with internal teams to support project requirements and ensure timely completion of assigned tasks. Perform other ad hoc IT support and operational duties as assigned. Hands-on experience providing end-user support for hardware, software, and workplace applications. Familiarity with Okta or other Identity and Access Management (IAM) platforms , including user provisioning, access management, and SSO troubleshooting. Exposure to MDM platforms such as Microsoft Intune, Jamf, or similar solutions , with an understanding of device enrollment, compliance, and endpoint security policies. Basic to intermediate knowledge of Windows and macOS operating systems, with experience supporting iOS devices . Familiarity with Google Workspace and other collaboration or SaaS applications. Exposure to cloud platforms such as AWS or GCP is an advantage. Strong analytical and problem-solving skills, with the ability to troubleshoot IT issues through log analysis, systematic investigation, and step-by-step tracing. Good understanding of endpoint security practices, including patching, antivirus, access control, and device compliance. Strong customer service and communication skills, with the ability to provide clear and effective support to end users. Proactive, adaptable, and willing to continuously learn new technologies and step outside your comfort zone. Strong teamwork and collaboration skills, with the ability to work effectively with internal teams and external vendors. Proficiency in both English and Mandarin as you will need to work closely with Chinese vendors. The role is based fully onsite, requiring your presence in the office.
